component.name: ReGa
component.summary: Play games on a cloud machine you own

description.p: ReGa is an early preview of an app that sets up a Windows gaming machine in your own cloud account and streams it to your desktop with Moonlight. This version suggests an AWS region by latency and price, launches, resizes, stops and destroys machines, installs Steam and Sunshine on them, and pairs Moonlight with a machine through its own WireGuard tunnel.
You enter your AWS access key in the app, which keeps it in the system keyring. It never uses credentials found elsewhere on the computer, such as ~/.aws. Until you enter a key it shows sample data.

screenshot.caption: Machine types with their specs and prices, and the region picker

description.p: You now enter your AWS access key in the app, which keeps it in the system keyring; ReGa no longer reads ~/.aws or environment variables. Adds an About box with a licence page and the AWS logo in the side menu, and a game library restore no longer stops short when a new machine's setup reboots it. The Flatpak is now built from source.

First preview. Launches, resizes, stops and destroys gaming machines on AWS, sets them up with Steam and Sunshine, streams them to Moonlight through a WireGuard tunnel, and saves their games to your own S3 bucket before they stop.
